value.rationale: Repeated eDNA assays at multiple template concentrations are motivated by competing copy scarcity and inhibitor dose, while false positives bias abundance inference. This proves the minimal exact number of dose levels for simultaneous identification under a natural, fully specified toy mechanism, gives a nonmonotonic trend classification, and rules out a physically spurious second solution. It is a useful sharp identifiability/design benchmark independent of later field validation; it is not claimed as an empirical optimum or general inhibition model.
